name: _panel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field/_panel.scss — the right-side dossier info panel: slide-in card,
//  header/tag/close, body, loading/tagline/history/source prose, facts
//  definition list, prose sections, and provenance signature.
//  Imported by star-field.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// A readable floating card — constrained to a ~38rem column, inset below
// the fixed nav chrome, and pinned to the same responsive gutter the site
// grid uses so it never overlaps the logo/burger or bleeds off-canvas.
.#{$_B_SF}-panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: $_NAV_INSET;
  right: to-rem($gap-272);
  bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  z-index: 40;
  width: min(#{to-rem($space-8xl)}, 92vw);
  translate: calc(100% + #{to-rem($space-4xl)}) 0;
  // Fully unpaintable while closed — a slide-only hide can leave the card's
  // border as a sliver at the screen edge on narrow/short viewports.
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    translate 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    visibility 0s linear 0.45s;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--sf-chrome);
  backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
  border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);
  color: var(--sf-ink);
  overflow: hidden;

  // Track the site's gutter at every grid step — mirrors %MAXAREA.
  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    right: to-rem($gap);
  }

  &--open {
    translate: 0 0;
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition:
      translate 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.3s ease;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  &-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
    padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-lg);
    border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line-2);
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-sm;

    margin: 0;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    flex: 1;
  }

  &-tag {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--sf-ink-2);
    border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &-close {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  &-body {
    overflow-y: auto;
    // Same containment as the nav sheet — dossier scrolls must not
    // chain to the page on mobile.
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding: to-rem($space-xl);
    flex: 1;
  }

  &-loading {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--sf-ink-2);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  &-tagline {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    margin: 0 0 to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  &-history {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    margin: to-rem($space-xl) 0;
  }

  &-source {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--sf-ink-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
}

// Facts definition list — label/value rows.
.#{$_B_SF}-facts {
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
}

.#{$_B_SF}-fact {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) 0;
  border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line-2);

  &-key {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--sf-ink-2);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin: 0;
  }

  &-val {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    text-align: right;
    margin: 0;
  }
}

// Dossier prose sections + provenance signature.
.#{$_B_SF}-panel-sec {
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--sf-ink-2);
    margin: 0 0 to-rem($space-xs);
  }

  &-body {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    margin: 0;
  }
}

.#{$_B_SF}-panel-sig {
  @extend .txt-xs;

  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--sf-ink-faint);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
}
